results.title: Panel lists S1 (score 100), S2 (41), S3 (6, the minimum) in that order; S4 (one shared word = 3) and S5 are not listed
Reasons shown: O1 "Same asset (X-1)", "Same asset type (Gearbox)", "Same failure mode (Bearing failure)"; O2 type+mode but no tag; O3 shared words only
Each match shows its root causes and "What fixed it" text; Open link goes to that investigation
"Copy this cause into my tree" adds it under the failure event as a Hypothesis (not verified, not a root cause, no evidence); button turns to "Copied"; message with link to the tree
The Cause tree step also shows the Similar past failures panel and a copy there adds under the selected cause
An investigation with no similar ones shows "No similar failures yet" guidance
An investigation is never listed as similar to itself and a copy of it (Duplicate) is listed as similar
